name: Wrapped Ratatoskr
description: Wrapped Ratatoskr (wRATR) is the Base representation of RATR, the native coin of the Ratatoskr chain — a yespower CPU-mined, masternode-secured network. Minted 1:1 against native RATR held in a public reserve via the Ratatoskr↔Base bridge. Part of the Enchanted Forest DeFi ecosystem.
